label: Environment removal accidentally removes every duplicate ID
rationale: A generic filtering rewrite changes this ordered environment operation from remove-first to remove-all, unlike index_remove. Full binding words and kinds after the first match must survive.

witness.expression: nc_remove_env([NC_Binding{7, "first", N_Box{}}, NC_Binding{8, "middle", N_W32{}}, NC_Binding{7, "second", N_W64{}}], 7)

domain: Finite typed helper environments including repeated IDs. No claim that every checked source lowering produces duplicates.

after: nt_choose(List<&2, NC_Binding>, U32.is_eq(at, id), u => nc_remove_env(rest, id), u => Con{NC_Binding{at, word, kind}, nc_remove_env(rest, id)})
